reviews.title: Great way to feel better!
reviews.text: I am not an exercise person. I am active, but I don’t enjoy exercise “routines”. But I also have aches and pains, that get more acute with each passing year. The Stretch app is easy to follow and gives me short lessons that really help me feel better. Sam’s laidback directions are easy to follow and fit well into my busy schedule.

reviews.title: Classes on my schedule
reviews.text: The follow along classes have really helped me in establishing a routine, and have helped me to understand the interconnectedness of different parts of my body. Sometimes back pain is tight hip and sometimes slouching is a tight chest. I can say with confidence that this app has improved my quality of life.

reviews.title: So worth it!!
reviews.text: This is a great comprehensive stretch program with great classes, great challenges, and lots of variability on level. Worth getting!!

reviews.title: THIS is what I’ve been searching for

reviews.title: Very miselading
reviews.text:
This looked like a good app for my needs.  Of course, it was listed as “Get,” meaning no cost, but with the ubiquitous “in-app purchases.”  I figured some content might be extra.

I opened the app, answered a few simple questions, and arrived at a screen showing payment option of at least $12.00 per month to even use the thing.  Waste of time and too expensive for a list of stretching exercises.  If you are looking for an app to pay $15.00 a month to use, check this one out.

reviews.title: Why hide it?
reviews.text: Not a fan of having to install an app and create a login just to see what the charges are. Most others at least list what to expect on their description in the App Store. I was expecting to need to pay, but I want to be able to assess that cost up front when making my decisions.

reviews.title: Just what we all need!  Sam is inspiring.

reviews.title: Helping to build a stretching habit!
reviews.text: I’m really enjoying this app.  Great content with lots of choices in the length of time throughout the videos. Not having to always commit to 30 minutes-an hour of a workout helps me stay consistent on the days when there just isn’t much free time. Sam has a very calming voice to listen to and is very clear when explaining different moves.  My one suggestion would be to make the breaks between the timed movements that some videos have a bit longer. Yes there is a pause button but it can be disruptive to have to be reaching out of position for it and sometimes I feel a little rushed. Otherwise this is a great little app that I love using!
